classifications.rationale: The President establishes and staffs an advisory commission and assigns it study and recommendation functions; these are internal organizational and advisory actions rather than changes to substantive legal rights.
classifications.evidence: There is established the National Commission on America's Urban Families

classifications.rationale: The provision itself gives Commission members an entitlement to authorized travel expenses and sets the Executive Director’s compensation ceiling, creating present compensation consequences subject only to administration.
classifications.evidence: they shall be entitled to travel expenses, including per diem in lieu of subsistence
